data.narrative:
Percepto is a Series C-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $128M to date. The valuation universe consists of seven private peers in the sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

Given the nascency of the commercial drone market, only one valuation method proved applicable: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised as a proxy base ($128M), a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $218M. This represents the median output of the analysis. A sensitivity range, applying ±15% variance around the stage-progression result, produces a low estimate of $185M and a high estimate of $250M.

The single-method conclusion reflects material data constraints. The broader peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier comparables to support median peer multiples; applying all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise given heterogeneous business models and capital intensity across autonomous vehicle categories. Key uncertainties include Percepto's revenue scale and unit economics relative to peers, which are not observable in this dataset, and the durability of stage-progression multiples in a sector where capital requirements and exit pathways remain in flux. The $185M–$250M range should be treated as indicative pending deeper operational due diligence.
